title: Don't want to be this guy, but I need Qwen 3.8 35B A3B
body: Qwen 3.8 27B is great, however it takes me ages to do tasks on xhigh. I need Qwen 3.8 35B A3B. It'll be a little dumber but faster. I am also aware of the fact that 27B gets its "intelligence" from the long thinking time. I therefore assume that 35B would also be a long-thinking model, however running Qwen 3.8 27B over night on my M1 Max for just one task is impractical and no fun. I love the progress and the work of
